_설명: 천일문 1권 Chapter 12 접속사 Chapter Test 뒷장(14~19번)에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 기초 13과 접속사 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: and, but, or: 같은 성격의 말을 잇는다

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 어법상 쓰임이 같은 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> I heard [[that]] the store closed early.

choices.text: Look at [[that]] tall tower.
I met [[that]] boy at the park.
She works in [[that]] office building.
We know [[that]] Jinho can speak Spanish.
He saw [[that]] was a mistake.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 어법상 쓰임이 다른 하나를 고르세요.

choices.text: [[When]] does the movie start?
She smiled [[when]] she saw the puppy.
Wear a coat [[when]] it is cold outside.
[[When]] I opened the door, the cat ran out.
He always sings [[when]] he takes a shower.

questions.point_label: and, or로 이어지는 말의 형태를 맞춘다
questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 알맞지 않은 두 개를 찾아 그 기호를 쓰고 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: Do you like baking and ⓐ [[decorate]] cakes? Or do you ⓑ [[want to learn]] new recipes?
Come and ⓒ [[be]] a member of our club! If you have any questions, ⓓ [[visit]] us in the cooking room or ⓔ [[calls]] us after school!

questions.point_label: 목적어 역할을 하는 that은 생략할 수 있다
questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분을 생략할 수 없는 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: We believed [[that]] she was honest.
I think [[that]] woman is our new coach.
Sora knows [[that]] he is very kind.
He hopes [[that]] the rain will stop.
I heard [[that]] there is a new café nearby.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 문맥상 어색한 문장을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: When I’m tired, I take a short nap.
Brush your teeth after you eat dinner.
He studied hard, and he failed the exam.
Mia is busy, but she will join us.
I felt cold if I didn’t wear my coat.

questions.prompt: 다음 글의 마지막 문장을 <조건>에 맞게 완성하세요.
body: My cousin, Junho, wants to be a movie director. Every weekend, he films short videos. So I ________ in the future.
<조건> • believe와 알맞은 접속사를 사용할 것  • 주어진 단어를 사용할 것
questions.answer: believe that he will be a great director
